scalars.scalar_value: Three (3) to five (5) years current Labor & Delivery experience

items.item_text: Current CA RN license BLS ACLS and NRP certifications
Certification in fetal monitoring is required within one (1) year of employment
Three (3) to five (5) years current Labor & Delivery experience
Circulating for cesarean delivery experience required.

Provides comprehensive antepartum, intrapartum, and postpartum nursing care, performing comprehensive maternal-fetal assessments, developing individualized care plans, and managing both low- and high-risk obstetric patients.

Monitors maternal and fetal well-being through external and internal fetal monitoring (FSE/IUPC), interpreted fetal heart tracings, performed cervical assessments, and initiated timely interventions during labor and obstetric emergencies.

Administers medications, IV therapies, epidural care, blood specimen collection, point-of-care testing, and other specialized clinical procedures while maintaining strict adherence to patient safety, infection prevention, and evidence-based practice.

Collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to coordinate patient care, provide SBAR handoffs, supervise and delegate nursing personnel, educate patients and families, advocate for patient-centered care, and ensure accurate clinical documentation and regulatory compliance.

Responds effectively to obstetric and neonatal emergencies, including fetal distress, hypertensive disorders, hemorrhage, preterm labor, and newborn stabilization, while promoting quality improvement, patient safety, and professional nursing standards.
Evidence of lactation support education required within one (1) year of employment required.
